module: Flowgraph node "Set Traffic Vehicle Data" (once_instant). Sets an active traffic vehicle: role (veh:setRole), enableActions (inverse of role.lockAction), enableRespawn, enableTracking, enablePoolCycle (enableAutoPooling), changePaint (useRandomPaint). Only non-nil pins are applied.

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

workOnce.desc: Applies the non-nil pins to traffic vehicle vehId (if it exists).
